args.title: Legacies of Colonialism in Contemporary Africa

items: European powers colonized Africa from the late 19th century.
Berlin Conference of 1884-1885 formalized territorial claims.
Colonial rule often involved exploitation of resources and labor.
Resistance movements emerged in response to colonial oppression.
Decolonization began post-World War II, leading to independence.
Political instability linked to arbitrary borders drawn during colonialism.
Economic dependency on former colonial powers persists.
Cultural impacts include language and education systems influenced by colonizers.
Social inequalities rooted in colonial policies continue to affect communities.
Ongoing debates about reparations and historical accountability.
